info.name: SSL Store WBAPI (SSL Store CA plugin)
info.description:
The actual SSL Store Web-Based API (WBAPI) calls the SSL Store CA plugin makes, grouped by operation flow. Use it to reproduce/debug what the plugin does against SSL Store directly.

## Base URL
- Sandbox: `https://sandbox-wbapi.thesslstore.com`
- Production: `https://wbapi.thesslstore.com`

## Authentication
SSL Store authenticates **in the request body**, not via headers. Every request includes an `AuthRequest` object with your `PartnerCode` and `AuthToken`. Set these in the `SSL Store WBAPI` environment. All calls are `POST` with `Content-Type: application/json`.

## Order identifiers
SSL Store returns `TheSSLStoreOrderID` (and `PartnerOrderID`) on `neworder`. Most follow-up calls take either `TheSSLStoreOrderID` or the `CustomOrderID` you supplied. Save `TheSSLStoreOrderID` from the neworder response into the `theSslStoreOrderId` variable and the follow-up calls will use it.

See [`../docs/enrollment-flows.md`](../docs/enrollment-flows.md) for how these map to the plugin operations.

item.name: 1. Enroll - New (Email DCV)
item.description: New DV/OV order validated by approver email. Flow: approverlist -> neworder -> (poll) status -> download.

request.description: Returns the list of approver emails allowed for the domain. The plugin validates the configured Approver Email against this list before ordering.

request.description: Creates the order. On success the response carries TheSSLStoreOrderID/PartnerOrderID (the test script saves TheSSLStoreOrderID). Contacts are required for OV; DV products (e.g. positivessl) may ignore them.

item.name: 2. Enroll - New (DNS CNAME DCV)
item.description: New order validated by CNAME. Flow: neworder (CNAMEAuthDVIndicator=true) -> plugin publishes the CNAME the response returns -> (poll) status -> download. Set CNAMEAuthDVIndicator to true.

request.description: CNAMEAuthDVIndicator=true requests CNAME DCV. The response contains the CNAME record (CNAMEAuthName -> CNAMEAuthValue, and per-domain entries under OrderStatus.DomainAuthVettingStatus) that the plugin publishes via the mapped CNAME DNS validator.

item.name: 3. Renew / Reissue
item.description: Renew = new order linked to the prior order (RelatedTheSSLStoreOrderID + isRenewalOrder). Reissue = same order, new CSR.

request.description: The plugin reads the prior order's expiry here to decide renew vs reissue against RenewalWindow.
Renewal is a new order with isRenewalOrder=true and RelatedTheSSLStoreOrderID set to the prior order.
Reissue keeps the same order and submits a new CSR.

item.name: 4. Status & Download (GetSingleRecord)
item.description: Poll a single order and download the issued certificate. Flow: status -> download when Active.

request.description: Returns OrderStatus.MajorStatus (Active/Pending/Cancelled). The plugin maps Active->GENERATED, Pending/Initial->EXTERNALVALIDATION, Cancelled->REVOKED. Can also query by CustomOrderID instead of TheSSLStoreOrderID.
Returns the certificate chain (Certificates[].FileContent). The plugin extracts the end-entity certificate. Only meaningful once the order is Active.

item.name: 5. Synchronize
item.description: Paginated order listing used by CA sync. Flow: query (per page) -> status -> download per order.

request.description: Returns a page of orders. The plugin walks pages (PageNumber++) until a short page, then fetches status + download for each. Optional filters: StartDate, EndDate, DomainName, ProductCode.

item.name: 6. Revoke (Refund request)
item.description: SSL Store models revocation as a refund request.

request.description: Revokes/refunds the order. Can also target CustomOrderID or SerialNumber. AuthResponse.isError indicates failure.
